summary_1line: After gaining near-invulnerability from Brahma, the Asura brothers Sunda and Upasunda conquer the heavens and begin destroying sacrifices and Brahmanas on earth.

image_candidates.scene_text: Brahma appears before the ascetic brothers Sunda and Upasunda as they stand with matted locks and folded palms amid the steaming Vindhya mountains.
The armored Asura army marches under the night sky while bards sing as Sunda and Upasunda rise into the heavens to conquer Indra’s realm.
Daitya warriors hurl blazing sacrificial fires into rivers while terrified sages and Brahmanas flee their shattered forest hermitages.
